{{Top|leg}}
The '''droid plasma thrower''' was an advanced [[Droid/Legends|droid]] utility item that had utilized ionized gas and had been capable of burning through most known metals in seconds. This device had been originally designed for rescue [[Droid/Legends|droids]] who sometimes needed to create holes in the heavily armored hulls of [[Starship/Legends|starships]].

==Behind the scenes==
A droid must be at upgrade class 3 to be able to equip this item.
